learn.overlap.adjust.title.text: An plano asin an budget pig-a-adjust para magtugma
learn.overlap.adjust.title.src: The plan and the budget are adjusted to match

learn.overlap.adjust.body.text: Mientrastanto tinatapos kan mga opisina an saindang mga plano, pig-aangkas na kan budget office an mga ini sa kwartang pig-aasahan na makolekta kan {lgu}. An mga bawas sa saro minabago sa saro pa, balikan, sagkod na mag-uyon sinda. Para sa budget na {fy}, natapos kan {lgu} pareho sa Oktubre {prev}.
learn.overlap.adjust.body.src: While offices finish their plans, the budget office is already fitting them to the money the {lgu} expects to collect. Cuts in one change the other, back and forth, until they agree. For the {fy} budget the {lgu} finished both in October {prev}.

learn.overlap.review.title.text: Nagpuon na an paggasto mientras padagos an nasyunal na check
learn.overlap.review.title.src: Spending starts while the national check runs

learn.overlap.review.body.text: Pwedeng maggasto an {lgu} puon Enero. An review kan nasyunal na gobyerno sa budget nagkakasabay sa parehong mga bulan, asin pwedeng tamaan asin haleon an sarong item na nalabag sa reglamento.
learn.overlap.review.body.src: The {lgu} can spend from January. The national government’s review of the budget happens in the same months, and can still strike out an item that breaks the rules.

learn.overlap.report.body.text: Nagrereport an mga opisina kan nagasto ninda sa bilog na taon, bako lang sa huri. An pinal na audit nangyayari pagkatapos kan taon.
learn.overlap.report.body.src: Offices report what they have spent through the year, not only at the end. The final audit comes after the year closes.

learn.hero.body.text: Haros duwang taon an paggibo asin pag-account para sa sarong taon na budget: puon sa inot na urulay manungod sa kaipohan kan {lgu} sagkod sa pinal na audit kan nagasto. Minaduman ini sa {count} stages, asin an iba sabay na nangyayari. Pumili nin arin man na stage tanganing mahiling kun ano an nangyayari, siisay an kalabot, asin sain ka pwedeng makabali.
learn.hero.body.src: One year’s budget takes almost two years to make and account for: from the first conversation about what the {lgu} needs to the final audit of what was spent. It passes through {count} stages, and some happen at the same time. Choose any stage to see what happens, who is involved, and where you can take part.

learn.s1.title.text: An budget kan {fy}, puon puon sagkod tapos.
learn.s1.title.src: The {fy} budget, from start to finish.

learn.s2.title.text: Bakong deretsong linya an mga stages.
learn.s2.title.src: The stages are not a straight line.

learn.s2.lede.text: Sa libro, an orden iyo plano nguna, dangan an budget. Sa aktwal, dakol na stages an nagsasapaw, asin an kada sapawni sarong moment na pwedeng maghira an figure.
learn.s2.lede.src: The textbook order is plan first, then budget. In practice several stages overlap, and each overlap is a moment when a figure can still move.

learn.s3.title.text: Mientras ginagasto an sarong budget, ginigibo na an masunod.
learn.s3.title.src: While one budget is being spent, the next one is being made.

learn.s3.lede.text: Kaya sa arin man na momento, an {lgu} yaon sa duwang lugar sa cycle.
learn.s3.lede.src: So at any moment the {lgu} is in two places in the cycle.

learn.s3.aria.text: Timeline: an budget kan {prev} piggagasto sa {prev} mientras an budget kan {fy} piggigibo; an budget kan {fy} piggagasto sa {fy} mientras an budget kan {next} piggigibo.
learn.s3.aria.src: Timeline: the {prev} budget is spent in {prev} while the {fy} budget is made; the {fy} budget is spent in {fy} while the {next} budget is made.

aipvs.meta.description.text: An pagkakaiba kan Annual Investment Program asin Annual Budget kan {shortName}: nuarin nag-eeksister an kada saro, tadaw ta magkaiba an saindang numero, asin kun ano an pigpapahiling saka dai pigpapahiling nin sarong budget figure.
aipvs.meta.description.src: The difference between {shortName}'s Annual Investment Program and its Annual Budget: when each exists, why their numbers differ, and what a budget figure does and does not mean.

aipvs.move.3.text: Pinagpuputol an mga request kan mga opisina para magkaigo sa piglalauman na income kan {lgu}. Digdi nagbabago an kadaklan na kantidad kan AIP.
aipvs.move.3.src: Offices’ requests are cut to fit the income the {lgu} expects. This is where most AIP amounts change.

aipvs.move.5.text: Pwedeng kwestiyunon asin putulon kan konseho {lgu} an mga item bago ini botohan.
aipvs.move.5.src: The {lguAdj} council can question and cut items before it votes.

aipvs.move.6.text: Pwedeng i-veto kan {Mayor} an partikular na mga item. Pwedeng i-override kan konseho an veto sa paagi nin dos-tercios na boto.
aipvs.move.6.src: The {Mayor} can veto particular items. The council can override a veto with a two-thirds vote.

aipvs.move.7.text: Pwedeng ideklara kan national budget department na mayong epekto an mga item na labag sa reglamento.
aipvs.move.7.src: The national budget department can declare items that break the rules without effect.

aipvs.move.8.text: Sa laog kan taon, an sarong supplemental budget, na saro man na ordinance, pwedeng magdugang o magbago kan budget.
aipvs.move.8.src: During the year, a supplemental budget, itself an ordinance, can add to or change the budget.

aipvs.hero.title.text: An plano asin ley bako parehong numero.
aipvs.hero.title.src: A plan and a law are not the same number.

aipvs.hero.body.text: Nagpapublikar an site na ini nin duwang dokumento hale sa magkabaliktad na poro kan {cycle}. An Annual Investment Program iyo an pigpaplano kan {lgu}; an Annual Budget iyo an puwede kaining gastuson. Ipinaliliwanag kan pahinang ini an pagkakaiba, tadaw ta magkaiba an saindang mga numero, asin kun ano an pigpapahiling saka dai pigpapahiling nin sarong numero sa site na ini.
aipvs.hero.body.src: This site publishes two documents from opposite ends of the {cycle}. The Annual Investment Program is what the {lgu} plans; the Annual Budget is what it may spend. This page explains the difference, why their figures differ, and what a figure on this site does and does not mean.

aipvs.s1.title.text: An saro request. An saro permiso.
aipvs.s1.title.src: One is a request. The other is permission.

aipvs.plan.body.text: Kun ano an pig-{propose} na gibuhon kan mga opisina kan {lgu} sa masunod na taon, asin kun gurano sa paghona ninda an magagastos. Ini pig-aasembol opisina por opisina sa laog nin mga bulan, kaya bako pang kompleto mantang pigsusurat, asin mayong pwedeng gastuson base sana digdi.
aipvs.plan.body.src: What the {lgu}’s offices {propose} to do next year, and what they think it will cost. It is assembled office by office over months, so it is incomplete while it is being written, and nothing may be spent on the strength of it.

aipvs.law.body.text: An budget pagkatapos na maipagkaigo an plano sa piglalauman na income kan {lgu}, maipasar kan Sanggunian, asin mapirmahan kan {Mayor}. Pinal na ini, asin ini an permiso para gumastos. An pagkumpara kaini sa saro pagkumpara nin sarong request sa nagin resulta.
aipvs.law.body.src: The budget once the plan has been fitted to the {lgu}’s expected income, passed by the Sanggunian, and signed by the {Mayor}. It is settled, and it is permission to spend. Comparing one to the other compares a request to an outcome.

aipvs.law.read.text: Basahon an na-enact na budget na {year}

aipvs.s1.foot.text: Sa site na ini an sarong taon nasa irarom kan {aip} mantang pigpreparar an budget kaini, asin minabalyo sa {annual} pag na-enact na ini.
aipvs.s1.foot.src: On this site a year sits under {aip} while its budget is being prepared, and moves to {annual} once it is enacted.

aipvs.s2.eyebrow.text: 02 · Tà daw ta nagkakalaen an mga numero

aipvs.s2.title.text: Limang punto kun sain pwedeng maghiro an kantidad.
aipvs.s2.title.src: Five points where an amount can move.

aipvs.s2.lede.text: Pwede magbago an kantidad sa pag-ultanan kan plano asin kan totoong piggastos, sa mga stage na ini kan cycle. An kada saro igwang link pasiring sa stage sa pahina kan cycle.
aipvs.s2.lede.src: Between the plan and the money actually spent, an amount can change at these stages of the cycle. Each links to the stage on the cycle page.

aipvs.s3.title.text: An sarong budget line permiso ini. An gastos, apat na steps pa pagkalaom.
aipvs.s3.title.src: A budget line is permission. Spending is four steps later.

aipvs.s3.lede.text: Ini an pinakalakop na paagi para sala an pagbasa kan bilog na site. An sarong appropriation nagtatao nin awtorisasyon sa sarong amount; bako ining rekord na an kuwarta nagduman na saen man.
aipvs.s3.lede.src: This is the most common way to misread the whole site. An appropriation authorizes an amount; it does not record that the money went anywhere.

entry.meta.description.text: Pano magbasa nin linya sa budget kan {placeName}: mga programa, proyekto asin aktibidad, kun sain nakabugtak an kuwarta, asin kun ano an boot sabihon kan reference code.
entry.meta.description.src: How to read a line in {placeName}’s budget: programs, projects and activities, where the money sits, and what the reference code means.

entry.hero.title.text: Ano an sinasabi saimo nin sarong linya sa budget.
entry.hero.title.src: What a line in the budget tells you.

entry.hero.body.text: An lambang entry sa site na ini igwa nin parehong mga parte: kun anong klase nin entry ini, gurano kadakul an dara kaini, siisay an may paninimbagan kaini, asin sarong reference code. Ipinaliliwanag kan pahinang ini an kada saro, gamit an mga itsura na ma-eencounter mo sa {browse}.
entry.hero.body.src: Every entry on this site has the same parts: what kind of entry it is, how much it carries, who is responsible for it, and a reference code. This page explains each, using the shapes you will meet in {browse}.

entry.s1.title.text: Nag-e-embed an mga entry, asin an sarong kantidad dai nin dobleng pagbilang.
entry.s1.title.src: Entries nest, and an amount is never counted twice.

entry.s1.p1.text: Nag-e-embed an mga entry sa budget. An sarong {program} grupo ini nin magkakarelasyon na trabaho, arog baga kan pagpaandar kan mga health center kan {lgu}. Sa laog kaini pwedeng mag-imbuesto nin mga {projects}, na may katapusan, asin mga {activities}, na nagpapadagos.
entry.s1.p1.src: Budget entries nest. A {program} is a group of related work, say, running the {lgu}’s health centers. Inside it can sit {projects}, which have an end, and {activities}, which are ongoing.

entry.s1.p2.text: An kantidad kan sarong programa pigsasabi na mismo sa programa o, kun naglilista ini nin mga proyekto asin aktibidad, iyo an suma kan sainda. Kadakul na programa nagsasabi kan sadiri nindang kantidad asin mayo nin nakalista sa irarom. Kun an sarong programa naglilista nin mga entry, an kuwarta nakarekord sa sainda. Kun an sarong programa asin an solamenteng entry sa laog kaini nagpapahiling nin parehong kantidad, saro sanang kantidad idto na duwang beses na pigsasambit, bako duwa.
entry.s1.p2.src: A program’s amount is either stated on the program itself or, when it lists projects and activities, the sum of theirs. Many programs state their own amount and list nothing beneath it. When a program does list entries, the money is recorded on them: if a program and the single entry inside it show the same amount, that is one amount described twice, not two.

entry.s1.p3.text: An kada entry pinapangaranan man an {office} na accountable para diyan, saro sa walong {finishLines} na pigtatrabahoan kaini, asin an {fund} na pinagkukuanan kan kuwarta.
entry.s1.p3.src: Each entry also names the {office} accountable for it, one of the eight {finishLines} it works toward, and the {fund} the money comes from.

entry.s2.title.text: An lambang entry igwa nin code. Deskripsiyon ini, bako serial number.
entry.s2.title.src: Every entry carries a code. It is a description, not a serial number.

entry.s2.lede.text: May mahihiling kang arog kan {code} sa kataid kan mga entry sa {browse}. An kada grupo nin mga digit nagsasabi kun sain nakabugtak an entry: an sector, an opisina, an seksiyon kan libro, asin an posisyon kaini sa laog.
entry.s2.lede.src: You will see something like {code} beside entries in {browse}. Each group of digits says where the entry sits: the sector, the office, the section of the book, and its position inside it.

code.sector.meaning.text: Kun saen na national na spending sector nag-aapil an trabaho. An 8000 iyo an Other Economic Services.
code.sector.meaning.src: Which national spending sector the work belongs to. 8000 is Other Economic Services.

code.officeType.meaning.text: Kun an opisina mandatory (01), optional (02) o iba pa (03) basado sa DBM manual.
code.officeType.meaning.src: Whether the office is mandatory (01), optional (02) or other (03) under the DBM manual.

code.office.meaning.text: An sadiring numero kan opisina sa coding sheet kan {lgu}. An 58 iyo an Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering Department.
code.office.meaning.src: The office's own number in the {lgu}'s coding sheet. 58 is the Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering Department.

code.section.meaning.text: Saen na seksyon kan budget book ini nag-imprenta: 001 General Administrative Services, 002 Support to Operations, 003 Operations.
code.section.meaning.src: Which section of the budget book it prints under: 001 General Administrative Services, 002 Support to Operations, 003 Operations.

code.program.meaning.text: An posisyon kan programa sa laog kan seksyon na idto. Poon giraray an bilang sa kada seksyon.
code.program.meaning.src: The program's position within that section. Counting restarts in each section.

code.entry.meaning.text: Kun arin na proyekto o aktibidad sa laog kan programa. An 000 boot sabihon an row iyo na mismo an programa.
code.entry.meaning.src: Which project or activity inside the program. 000 means the row is the program itself.

code.caption.text: An AIP reference code 8000-2-03-58-002-001-000 na binanga sa pitong segment, an kada saro ipinaliwanag sa listahan sa ibaba.
code.caption.src: The AIP reference code 8000-2-03-58-002-001-000 broken into its seven segments, each explained in the list below.

code.not.text: Duwang bagay na {not} ginigibo kan code. Dai ini nag-a-add up — an code kan programa sarong label, bako total kan mga entries sa irarom kaini. Asin mayo ini dara na taon, kaya an parehong code pwedeng i-issue giraray para sa sunod na budget.
code.not.src: Two things the code does {not} do. It does not add up — a program’s code is a label, not a total of the entries beneath it. And it carries no year, so the same code is issued again for the next budget.

money.appropriation.what.text: An ordinance nagtatao nin awtorisadong amount para sa sarong katuyuhan. Permiso para gumastos.
money.appropriation.what.src: The ordinance authorizes an amount for a purpose. Permission to spend.

money.allotment.what.text: An opisina tinatawan na nin autoridad para punan na i-commit an kuwarta.
money.allotment.what.src: The office is released the authority to start committing that money.

money.obligation.what.text: May kontratang pinirmahan o payroll na ginibo. An {lgu} obligado nang magbayad.
money.obligation.what.src: A contract is signed or a payroll run. The {lgu} is now bound to pay.

money.disbursement.what.text: An cash talagang naghahale sa treasury. Sa puntong ini pa sana nagastos an kuwarta.
money.disbursement.what.src: Cash actually leaves the treasury. Only now has money been spent.

money.caption.text: Lambang pigura sa site na ini iyo an step one. Kun an kuwarta na-commit na o talagang nabayadan, masasimbag sa accountability reports kan {lgu}, bako digdi.
money.caption.src: Every figure on this site is step one. Whether the money was committed or actually paid is answered in the {lgu}’s accountability reports, not here.

ppa.programNote.text: An kantidad kaini iyo an sum kan mga entries sa ibaba
ppa.programNote.src: Its amount is the sum of the entries below

ppa.caption.text: Kaya kun an sarong programa asin an solamenteng entry sa laog kaini pareho an pigpapahiling na kantidad, saro sanang kantidad iyan na pigladawan sa duwang lebel — bako ining duwang kantidad. Dakul na programa an mayong nililistang proyekto o aktibidad; an pigtatao ninda iyo an saindang sadiring kantidad.
ppa.caption.src: So if a program and the one entry inside it show the same amount, that is one amount described at two levels — not two amounts. Many programs list no projects or activities at all; they state their own amount instead.

glossary.hero.body.text: Solamenteng mga termino na talagang masasabat mo sa site na ini. An kada saro sarong pakasabot sa simpleng lengguwahe; para sa ano man na gusto mong sitaron, gamiton an opisyal na dokumento.
glossary.hero.body.src: Only terms you will actually meet on this site. Each is a plain-language paraphrase; for anything you intend to cite, use the official document.

glossary.termsNote.text: An mga termino sa budget pinapagdadanay sa English, siring kan pagkalataw ninda sa mga dokumento kan {lgu}.
glossary.termsNote.src: Budget terms are kept in English, as they appear in the {lgu}’s documents.

aipov.meta.description.text: An laog kan draft nin {place} na Annual Investment Program — an mga programang pigpublikar, kan mga opisina, asin kun nano an pigmamawot na makamtan.
aipov.meta.description.src: What {place}'s draft Annual Investment Program contains so far — the programs published, by which offices, and what they are meant to achieve.

aipov.plan.lede1.text: An Annual Investment Program iyo an pig-aabiso kan mga opisina kan {lgu} na gibuhon sa masunod na taon.
