explore.ask.matched.text: Ini kapareho nin sarong hapot na parating pig-uusisa. Ipinapahiling kan chart sa ibaba ini.
explore.ask.matched.src: This matches a question people often ask. The chart below shows it.

explore.ask.nearest.text: Dipisil iyan tultulon, kaya ini an pinakaharaning chart na yaon sa samo. Ribayan an menus sa ibaba kun sala ini.
explore.ask.nearest.src: That one was hard to work out, so here is the closest chart we have. Change the menus below if it is not right.

explore.ask.notUnderstood.text: Dai iyan kayang gibuhon na chart. Magtry nin saro sa mga ini, o maghapot sa ibang paagi.
explore.ask.notUnderstood.src: That could not be turned into a chart. Try one of these, or ask in a different way.

explore.ask.resting.text: Nagpupahingalo nguna an mga bagong hapot ngunyan. Magtry nin saro sa mga hapot na ini na parating pig-uusisa:
explore.ask.resting.src: New questions are resting for today. Try one of these questions people often ask:

explore.ask.guessedLine.text: Nahulaan: {fields}. Ribayan sinda sa menus sa ibaba kun sala sinda.
explore.ask.guessedLine.src: Guessed: {fields}. Change them in the menus below if they are wrong.

explore.ask.notWhatYouMeant.text: Bakong iyo ini an boot mong sabihon? I-edit an saimong hapot
explore.ask.notWhatYouMeant.src: Not what you meant? Edit your question

explore.ask.limit.text: Dakulon na an saimong hinapot sa halipot na panahon. Paki-ulay, halat nguna nin kadikit asin magtry giraray.
explore.ask.limit.src: You have asked a lot of questions in a short time. Please wait a little and try again.

explore.ask.failed.text: Dai iyan nagdalagan. Paki-try giraray sa huri.
explore.ask.failed.src: That did not work. Please try again later.

explore.mic.listening.text: Nakikiaram. Sabihon an saimong hapot, dangan pinduton an Pundo.
explore.mic.listening.src: Listening. Say your question, then press Stop.

explore.mic.heard.text: Ini an samong nadangog. Riberuhon asin husayon an ano man na tataramon, dangan pinduton an Haputon.
explore.mic.heard.src: Here is what we heard. Check it and fix any words, then press Ask.

explore.mic.error.denied.text: Dai tinutugutan an mikropono. Tuguti ini sa saimong browser, o i-type an saimong hapot.
explore.mic.error.denied.src: The microphone is not allowed. Allow it in your browser, or type your question.

explore.mic.error.empty.text: Mayong nadangog. Purbaran giraray, magin harani sa telepono, o i-type na sana an saimong hapot.
explore.mic.error.empty.src: Nothing was heard. Try again a little closer to the phone, or type your question.

explore.mic.error.limit.text: Dakul na beses mong ginamit an mikropono sa halipot na panahon. Paki-type na sana an saimong hapot, o purbaran giraray sa huri.
explore.mic.error.limit.src: You have used the microphone a lot in a short time. Please type your question, or try again later.

explore.mic.error.failed.text: Dai iyan naggana. Paki-type na sana an saimong hapot, o purbaran giraray sa huri.
explore.mic.error.failed.src: That did not work. Please type your question, or try again later.

explore.invalid.text: Dai maipahiling an link na iyan sa dati kaining itsura, kaya uya ngona an starting chart.
explore.invalid.src: That link could not be shown as it was, so here is the starting chart instead.

explore.empty.text: Mayong nagtutugma sa mga filter na ini. Maghalion saro tanganing makahiling nin orog pa.
explore.empty.src: Nothing matches these filters. Remove one to see more.

explore.share.note.text: An siisay man na igwa kaining link, mahihiling an eksaktong chart na ini.
explore.share.note.src: Anyone with this link sees this exact chart.

explore.explain.largest.text: An pinakadakula iyo an {row}, na nagkakantidad nin {value} ({pct}% kan kabilogan).
explore.explain.largest.src: The largest is {row}, at {value} ({pct}% of the total).

explore.explain.largestIn.text: Sa {series}, an pinakadakula iyo an {row}, na nagkakantidad nin {value} ({pct}% kan kabilogan).
explore.explain.largestIn.src: In {series}, the largest is {row}, at {value} ({pct}% of the total).

explore.explain.topThree.text: An tolong pinakadakula pinagsaro iyo an {pct}% kan total.
explore.explain.topThree.src: The three largest together make up {pct}% of the total.

explore.explain.smallest.text: An pinakasadit na ipinapahiling iyo an {row}, sa kantidad na {value}.

explore.explain.changeUp.text: An pinakadakulang pagbabago iyo an {period}: nagdakula nin {delta}{pct}.
explore.explain.changeUp.src: The biggest change is {period}: up by {delta}{pct}.

explore.explain.changeDown.text: An pinakadakulang pagbabago iyo an {period}: nagdikit nin {delta}{pct}.
explore.explain.changeDown.src: The biggest change is {period}: down by {delta}{pct}.

explore.explain.limitsHeading.src: What this does not tell you

explore.explain.limit.estimated-cost-not.text: Ini an mga estimated costs kan mga nakaplanong programa. Dai kaini ipinapahiling kun ano an ginasto o kun ano an nagibo.
explore.explain.limit.estimated-cost-not.src: These are estimated costs of planned programs. They do not show what was spent or what was done.

explore.explain.limit.kinds-differ.text: An plano, an proposed budget asin an enacted budget magkakalaen na dokumento. Ipinapahiling sinda magkaibong, asin dai nuarin man pigsasalak.
explore.explain.limit.kinds-differ.src: The plan, the proposed budget and the enacted budget are different documents. They are shown side by side, never added together.

explore.explain.limit.tags-overlap.text: An sarong programa pwedeng mabilang sa labi sa sarong theme, kaya an mga theme dai nag-aadd up sa total.
explore.explain.limit.tags-overlap.src: A program can count under more than one theme, so the themes do not add up to the total.

explore.explain.limit.count-of-ppas.text: Sa sarong Annual Budget an bilang nin mga programa, proyekto asin aktibidad iyo an siring sa lista kan ordinance.
explore.explain.limit.count-of-ppas.src: On an Annual Budget the count is of programs, projects and activities as the ordinance lists them.

explore.explain.limit.default.text: Ini mga budget figure. Dai kaini ipinapahiling kun ano an ginasto o kun ano an nagibo.
explore.explain.limit.default.src: These are budget figures. They do not show what was spent or what was done.

explore.explain.footer.text: Isinurat hali sa mga figure sa table, gamit an fixed sentences, bako nin AI. I-tap an sarong figure tanganing mahiling an row kaini.
explore.explain.footer.src: Written from the figures in the table, with fixed sentences, not by AI. Tap a figure to see its row.

explore.feedback.question.text: Tama daw an paliwanag na ini?

explore.feedback.thanks.text: Dios mabalos. Ini nakakatabang samo na mapakarhay an mga paliwanag.
explore.feedback.thanks.src: Thank you. This helps us improve the explanations.

explore.feedback.failed.text: Dai iyan nakapadara. Paki-try giraray pag-agi nin panahon.
explore.feedback.failed.src: That did not send. Please try again later.

explore.noYears.text: Mayo pa nin na-publish na budget, kaya mayong ma-chart. Baliki pag may pigpublikar na an {lgu}.
explore.noYears.src: No budget has been published yet, so there is nothing to chart. Check back once the {lgu} publishes one.

explore.unavailable.text: An explorer dai available ngunyan. Paki-try giraray sa pirang minuto.
explore.unavailable.src: The explorer is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

explore.ws.notSaved.text: Dai naka-save: mayong tinatago an browser na ini
explore.ws.notSaved.src: Not saved: this browser keeps nothing

explore.ws.copyLink.text: Kopyaha an link pasiring sa workbook na ini
explore.ws.copyLink.src: Copy a link to this workbook

explore.ws.linkCopied.text: Nakopya na an link. Nagbubukas ini nin kopya kan workbook na ini.
explore.ws.linkCopied.src: Link copied. It opens a copy of this workbook.

explore.ws.linkFailed.text: Dai nakagibo nin link. Paki-otro tabi.
explore.ws.linkFailed.src: Could not make a link. Please try again.

explore.ws.replaceConfirm.text: Buksan an shared workbook? Saluyngan kaini an naka-save sa browser na ini. Pwedeng i-undo ini.
explore.ws.replaceConfirm.src: Open the shared workbook? It replaces the one saved in this browser. You can undo this.

explore.ws.rec.expand.text: Ipahiling an mga proyekto asin aktibidad kan {n}

explore.ws.rec.collapse.text: Itago an mga proyekto asin aktibidad kan {n}

explore.ws.rec.derived.text: Kun pano ini binabasa kan explorer

explore.ws.rec.derivedNote.text: An sadiring basa kan explorer sa row na ini, hali sa pangaran asin tags kaini, tanganing matabangan ka sa paghanap. Dai ini itinakda kan {lgu}.
explore.ws.rec.derivedNote.src: The explorer's own reading of this row, from its name and tags, to help you search. The {lgu} did not set these.

explore.lint.empty.text: kada value zero, kaya mayong madrowing.
explore.lint.empty.src: every value is zero, so there is nothing to draw.

explore.lint.tooManyCategories.text: sobrang dakul na kategorya para basahon bilang chart. I-set an Top N tanganing igrupo an iba bilang Other.
explore.lint.tooManyCategories.src: too many categories to read as a chart. Set Top N to group the rest as Other.

explore.lint.tooManySeries.text: sobra sa walong series an mag-uulit nin mga kolor. Halion an sarong breakdown o filter.
explore.lint.tooManySeries.src: more than eight series would repeat colours. Remove a breakdown or filter.

explore.lint.mixedUnits.text: an mga amounts nasa magkakaibang units asin dai pwedeng maghiras nin sarong axis.
explore.lint.mixedUnits.src: the amounts are in different units and cannot share one axis.

explore.lint.ratioStacked.text: an mga porsyento nin magkakaibang kabilugan dai nagkakadugangan, kaya dai ini pwedeng i-stack.
explore.lint.ratioStacked.src: percentages of different wholes do not add up, so they cannot be stacked.

explore.lint.negativeArea.text: an negative amount mayo nin sukol sa sarong part-to-whole chart.
explore.lint.negativeArea.src: a negative amount has no size in a part-to-whole chart.

explore.lint.rankAsLength.text: an rank sarong posisyon, bako amount, kaya dai ini pigdadrowing bilang laba.
explore.lint.rankAsLength.src: a rank is a position, not an amount, so it is not drawn as a length.

explore.lint.lineUnordered.text: an line nagdudugtong nin mga value sa pagkasunod-sunod, asin an breakdown na ini daing order. I-try an bar.
explore.lint.lineUnordered.src: a line joins values in order, and this breakdown has no order. Try a bar.

explore.lint.onePoint.text: sarong value bako ining trend. Magpili nin mas dakul na taon.
explore.lint.onePoint.src: one value is not a trend. Pick more years.

explore.lint.fewPoints.text: an scatter kaipuhan nin kisera tulong puntos.
explore.lint.fewPoints.src: a scatter needs at least three points.

explore.lint.heatmapThin.text: an heat map kaipuhan nin kisera duwang row asin duwang column.
explore.lint.heatmapThin.src: a heat map needs at least two rows and two columns.

explore.lint.kpiMany.text: sobra sa doseng dakulang numero mas maray basahon bilang table.
explore.lint.kpiMany.src: more than twelve big numbers read better as a table.

explore.lint.otherDominates.text: An Other mas dakula kisa sa gabos na ipinapahiling. Itaas an Top N.
explore.lint.otherDominates.src: Other is bigger than everything shown. Raise Top N.

explore.ws.shelves.text: Kun ano an ipinapahiling kan chart

explore.lint.mapTotals.text: An map kan totals, parati ipinapahiling sana kun sain nag-iistar an mga tawo. Pumili nin Per resident.
explore.lint.mapTotals.src: a map of totals mostly shows where people live. Choose Per resident.

explore.guide.starter.places.name.text: Sain sa {lgu} napaduman an FY{year} AIP
explore.guide.starter.places.name.src: Where in the {lgu} the FY{year} AIP goes

explore.guide.starter.places.blurb.text: An mga proyekto asin aktibidad kan plano kada barangay, per resident (PSA 2020 population), basado sa sinasabi kan kada saro kun sain ini. An pondo na mayong binabanggit na barangay ipinapahiling nin solo. An sarong proyekto sa duwang barangay binibilang sa duwa, kaya an mga barangay dai nuarin man pinagsasaro.
explore.guide.starter.places.blurb.src: The plan's projects and activities by barangay, per resident (PSA 2020 population), read from where each one says it is. Money that names no barangay is shown on its own. A project in two barangays counts in both, so barangays are never added up.

explore.guide.starter.words.name.text: An mga tataramon na piggagastusan kan FY{year} AIP
explore.guide.starter.words.name.src: The words the FY{year} AIP spends on

explore.guide.starter.words.blurb.text: Mga tataramon hale sa mga pangaran kan programa, an kada saro kadakula kan pondo kan mga programang nagamit kaini, kinuloran base sa label na pinakasagin digdi. An sarong programa nagagamit nin nagkapirang tataramon, kaya an mga tataramon dai nuarin man pinagsasaro. I-klik an sarong tataramon para mahiling an mga programang nagamit kaini.
explore.guide.starter.words.blurb.src: Words from program names, each as big as the money of the programs that use it, coloured by the label it is most typical of. A program uses several words, so the words are never added up. Click a word to see the programs that use it.

explore.ws.calc.percentDifferenceFromPre.text: % na pagbabago poon kan nakaaging taon

explore.ws.pictureSource.text: Source: an mga pinalagda na dokumento kan budget · {placeName} Data Explorer, {url}
explore.ws.pictureSource.src: Source: the published budget documents · {placeName} Data Explorer, {url}

explore.ws.invalid.text: Dai madrowing an sheet na ini. {reasons}

explore.ws.empty.text: Mayong nagtutugma sa mga filter na ini.

explore.ws.neverAdded.text: Pigpapahiling an magkakalaen na dokumento asin taon magkairibahan, dai pinagsasaro. An AIP sarong plano; an ordinance sana an nag-aapropriar.
explore.ws.neverAdded.src: Different documents and years are shown side by side, never added together. An AIP is a plan; only the ordinance appropriates.

explore.ws.chatNote.text: Kada pigura, pigche-check kontra sa data
explore.ws.chatNote.src: Every figure is checked against the data

explore.ws.welcome.text: Maghapot nin question, o magpili nin fields sa wala.
explore.ws.welcome.src: Ask a question, or pick fields on the left.

explore.ws.welcomeNote.text: An chart asin an controls sarô sana: baguhon an saro asin masunod an saro.
explore.ws.welcomeNote.src: The chart and the controls are one: change either and the other follows.

explore.ws.askPlaceholder.text: Maghagad nin chart, arog kan “health spending sa 2027”
explore.ws.askPlaceholder.src: Ask for a chart, like “health spending in 2027”

explore.ws.guessed.text: Nahulaan: {fields}. Baguhon iyan sa itaas kan chart kun sala sinda.
explore.ws.guessed.src: Guessed: {fields}. Change them above the chart if they are wrong.

explore.ws.matched.text: Ini nagtutugma sa sarong hapot na parating pigkakahapot kan mga tawo. Ipinapahiling kan chart.
explore.ws.matched.src: This matches a question people often ask. The chart shows it.

explore.ws.nearest.text: Idto masakit trabahuhon, kaya ini an pinakaharaning chart na yaon samo. Baguhon an shelves sa itaas kan chart kun bako ining tama.
explore.ws.nearest.src: That one was hard to work out, so here is the closest chart we have. Change the shelves above the chart if it is not right.

explore.ws.desktopOnly.text: Nagbubukas an shared workbooks sa computer o sa wide screen.
explore.ws.desktopOnly.src: Shared workbooks open on a computer or a wide screen.

explore.ws.pick.hint.text: Keep, exclude, i‑drill down o ilista an mga rekord
explore.ws.pick.hint.src: Keep, exclude, drill down or list the records

explore.ws.board.hint.text: I‑click an bar, point o box para i‑filter an ibang sheets base kaini. I‑click giraray ini para i‑clear.
explore.ws.board.hint.src: Click a bar, point or box to filter the other sheets to it. Click it again to clear.

explore.ws.board.notLinked.text: Dai naka‑link: mayong siring na field

explore.ws.tileInvalid.text: An sheet na ini dai maipapahiling sa siring na selection.
explore.ws.tileInvalid.src: This sheet cannot be shown with that selection.

explore.chat.welcome.text: Maghapot manungod sa budget sa English, Filipino o Bikol.
explore.chat.welcome.src: Ask about the budget in English, Filipino or Bikol.

explore.chat.welcomeNote.text: An mga tema arog kan “flood control” o “para sa mga senior citizens” pigbabasar sa kun ano an kada PPA, bako sa opisina an nagpapadalagan kaini. An lambang pigura hali sa data.
explore.chat.welcomeNote.src: Themes like “flood control” or “for senior citizens” are counted from what each PPA is, not which office runs it. Every figure comes from the data.

explore.consent.label.text: Tabangan na mapakarhay an explorer: papagdanayon an hapot na ini, na hinale an mga pangaran asin kontak, tanganing tukduan an modelo kan {lgu}.
explore.consent.label.src: Help improve the explorer: keep this question, with names and contacts removed, to teach the {lgu}'s model.

explore.chat.placeholder.text: Maghapot, arog kan “gurano an para sa flood control?”
explore.chat.placeholder.src: Ask, like “how much is for flood control?”

explore.chat.counted.text: Pigbabasar sa kun ano an kada PPA, bako sa opisina an nagpapadalagan kaini.
explore.chat.counted.src: Counted from what each PPA is, not which office runs it.

explore.chat.unclassified.text: An {count} na mga row ({amount}) dai ma-classify.

explore.chat.review.text: An mga label na dai sigurado an classifier hinahali nguna hasta dae pa naberipika.
explore.chat.review.src: Labels the classifier was unsure of are left out until reviewed.

explore.chat.draft.text: Kaiba an sarong draft na dokumento, bako pang pampubliko.
explore.chat.draft.src: Includes a draft document, not yet public.

explore.chat.notUnderstood.text: Dai ko iyan nagibong chart. Puwede mong probaran na magsambit nin tema, opisina o taon.
explore.chat.notUnderstood.src: I could not turn that into a chart. Try naming a theme, an office or a year.

explore.chat.noData.text: An data mayo nin dokumento para sa taon o klase na iyan. Ini an mga yaon:
explore.chat.noData.src: The data has no document for that year or kind. These exist:

explore.chat.empty.text: Mayo nin nagmamatch na ano man sa data.
explore.chat.empty.src: Nothing in the data matches that.

explore.chat.wider.text: Kun mayo an search sa pangaran

explore.chat.resting.text: An chat nagpapahingalo ngonian na aldaw. Puwede ka pa man giraray maghimo nin mga chart gamit an mga field sa wala.
explore.chat.resting.src: The chat is resting for today. You can still build charts with the fields on the left.

explore.guide.description.text: Paano gamiton an explorer, mga starter workbook, asin kun ano an laog kan data.
explore.guide.description.src: How to use the explorer, starter workbooks, and what the data holds.

explore.guide.start.ask.text: Mag-type nin hapot sa chat, arog kan “health spending sa 2027”. An saimong sheet mabago para simbagon ini, asin an Undo an mabalik kaini sa dati.
explore.guide.start.ask.src: Type a question in the chat, like “health spending in 2027”. Your sheet changes to answer it, and Undo puts it back.

explore.guide.start.drag.text: I-drag an sarong breakdown, arog kan Office, hale sa lista sa walang parte pasiring sa Rows, o i-klik lang ini. An chart tulos na magdrodrowing.
explore.guide.start.drag.src: Drag a breakdown, such as Office, from the list on the left onto Rows, or just click it. The chart draws at once.

explore.guide.start.starter.text: Buksi an sarong tapos nang workbook sa ibaba asin siyasaton ini. Ini an masalida sa saimong workbook; an Undo an mabalik kan saimo.
explore.guide.start.starter.src: Open a finished workbook below and pick it apart. It replaces your workbook; Undo brings yours back.

explore.guide.starter.aip.blurb.text: An estimated cost kan plano kada opisina, kada {goal} asin kada klase nin gastos, magkakaibahan.
explore.guide.starter.aip.blurb.src: The plan's estimated cost by office, by {goal} and by type of expense, side by side.

explore.guide.starter.climate.blurb.text: Plan money tagged for adapting to and slowing climate change, by type and by office.
explore.guide.starter.climate.blurb.src: Plan money tagged for adapting to and slowing climate change, by type and by office.

explore.guide.starter.income.name.text: Where the FY{year} money comes from
explore.guide.starter.income.name.src: Where the FY{year} money comes from

explore.guide.starter.income.blurb.text: An income na pig-eexpect kan {lgu}, by class asin an sampulong pinakadakulang sources. An income dai nuarin man pigdadagdag sa spending.
explore.guide.starter.income.blurb.src: The income the {lgu} expects, by class and its ten largest sources. Income is never added to spending.

explore.guide.starter.overTime.name.text: An budget sa pag-agi nin mga taon

explore.guide.starter.overTime.blurb.text: An lambang dokumento sa site na ini, saro kada linya. An mga plano, proposals asin enacted budgets magkakaibang kwarta, kaya dai sinda pigdadagdag nuarin man.
explore.guide.starter.overTime.blurb.src: Every document on this site, one line each. Plans, proposals and enacted budgets are different money, so they are never added together.

explore.guide.howto.chart.text: Magpili nin amount para sa Columns asin breakdown para sa Rows. An Marks, sa wala, nagbabago kan klase nin chart.
explore.guide.howto.chart.src: Choose an amount for Columns and a breakdown for Rows. Marks, on the left, changes the kind of chart.

explore.guide.howto.compareTitle.text: Ikompara an mga taon o dokumento.

explore.guide.howto.compare.text: Mag-tick nin labi sa saro sa irarom kan Documents. Ipinapahiling sinda magkatakod, dai nuarin man pigdadagdag.
explore.guide.howto.compare.src: Tick more than one under Documents. They are shown side by side, never added together.

explore.guide.howto.filter.text: Pindoton an + pagkatapos kan “where”, o i-drag an field pasiring sa Filters.
explore.guide.howto.filter.src: Press + after “where”, or drag a field onto Filters.

explore.guide.howto.drill.text: I-click an bar, point o box (o sarong pangaran sa Table view) para papagdanayon sana ini, haleon, i-drill down kun ano an nasa laog kaini, o i-lista an mga records kaini.
explore.guide.howto.drill.src: Click a bar, point or box (or a name in the Table view) to keep only it, leave it out, drill down to what is inside it, or list its records.

explore.guide.howto.recordsTitle.text: Hilingon an mga linya sa likod nin sarong chart.
explore.guide.howto.recordsTitle.src: See the rows behind a chart.

explore.guide.howto.records.text: An Records naglilista kan mga programa, PPAs o account lines, 50 sa sarong pagkakataon. I-click an pangaran nin column para i-sort.
explore.guide.howto.records.src: Records lists the programs, PPAs or account lines, 50 at a time. Click a column name to sort.

explore.guide.howto.boardTitle.text: Ipatakod sa gilid an mga chart.

explore.guide.howto.board.text: An bagong dashboard, sa ibaba, nagpapahiling nin sagkod sa apat na sheets. An sarong click sa saro nagpi-filter kan iba.
explore.guide.howto.board.src: New dashboard, at the bottom, shows up to four sheets. A click in one filters the others.

explore.guide.howto.share.text: An saimong workbook natatagama sana sa browser na ini. An Share naggigibo nin link na nagbubukas nin kopya para sa siisay man, o nagda-download nin ritrato o kan mga figures.
explore.guide.howto.share.src: Your workbook is saved in this browser only. Share makes a link that opens a copy for anyone, or downloads a picture or the figures.

explore.guide.sourcesHead.text: Ano an laog kan kada source

explore.guide.key.help.text: Buksan o isara an giyang ini

explore.guide.key.enter.text: Magdagdag nin field, magbukas nin menu, o magbukas kan menu nin pangaran sa Table view
explore.guide.key.enter.src: Add a field, open a menu, or open a name's menu in the Table view

explore.guide.key.esc.text: Isara an sarong menu o an giyang ini
explore.guide.key.esc.src: Close a menu or this guide

explore.guide.about.docsHead.text: Mga dokumento sa site na ini

explore.guide.about.docsNote.text: An sarong taon pwedeng magkaigwa nin sagkod tulong dokumento. Mga lakdang sinda nin sarong budget, bako nin tulong budget.
explore.guide.about.docsNote.src: A year can have up to three documents. They are steps of one budget, not three budgets.

explore.guide.about.kind.lep.text: Local Expenditure Program (LEP), an propwesta ni {Mayor}

explore.guide.about.money.aip.text: An pig-aasahan na magagasto sa sarong nakaplanong programa kun iyo an sunudon. An plano mas dakol an nakalista kisa sa kaya kan {lgu}, kaya an estimated cost bako ining budget asin dae ini nagapromesa nin kuwarta.
explore.guide.about.money.aip.src: What a planned program is expected to cost if it is carried out. The plan lists more than the {lgu} can afford, so an estimated cost is not a budget and promises no money.

explore.guide.about.money.lep.text: An hinahagad ni {Mayor} na aprubaran kan {council} para sa masunod na taon, pinababa hali sa plano para magkaigo sa pig-aasahan na income kan {lgu}. Pwede pa ining magbago.
explore.guide.about.money.lep.src: What the {Mayor} asks the {council} to approve for next year, cut down from the plan to fit the income the {lgu} expects. It can still change.

explore.guide.about.money.ordinance.text: An piginaging ley kan {council}. Ini sana an nagtutugot sa {lgu} na maggasto, asin sagkod sana sa kantidad na iyan. Permiso ini para magasto, bako ining rekord kan gastadong kuwarta.
explore.guide.about.money.ordinance.src: What the {council} passes into law. Only this lets the {lgu} spend, and only up to that amount. It is permission to spend, not a record of money spent.

explore.guide.about.never.text: Huli ta magkakaiba an kuwartang ini, ipinapahiling sinda kan explorer na magkaibahan an pagkaagid asin dae nauunpisa na pagsararuon. An mga taon dae man nauunpisa na pinagsasaro.
explore.guide.about.never.src: Because these are different money, the explorer shows them side by side and never adds them together. Years are never added together either.

explore.guide.about.draft.text: An draft sarong dokumento na dae pa pigpupublikar kan {lgu} sa site na ini. Nagpapahiling sana an mga draft sa mga test copy kan site, tanganing mai-check ini kan team, asin lambang pigura sa draft may darang Draft label asin stripes. An mga pigura kaini pwedeng magbago pa.
explore.guide.about.draft.src: A draft is a document the {lgu} has not published on this site yet. Drafts show only on test copies of the site, so the team can check them, and every draft figure carries a Draft label and stripes. Its figures may still change.

explore.guide.about.draftHere.text: Ining kopya kan site nagpapahiling nin mga draft.
explore.guide.about.draftHere.src: This copy of the site shows drafts.

explore.guide.about.draftNone.text: Ining site dae nagpapahiling nin mga draft.

explore.guide.about.caveat.published.text: An mga pigpublikar na sana kan {lgu} an yaon digdi. An sarong taon na mayong pigpublikar dae naililista.
explore.guide.about.caveat.published.src: Only what the {lgu} has published is here. A year with nothing published is not listed.

explore.guide.about.caveat.lep.text: Para sa nagkapirang nakaaging taon, an propwesta sana ni {Mayor} (LEP) an pigpaskil kan {lgu}, kaya an mga taon na idto mayong enacted budget digdi.
explore.guide.about.caveat.lep.src: For some past years the {lgu} posted only the {Mayor}'s proposal (LEP), so those years have no enacted budget here.

explore.guide.about.caveat.themes.text: An sarong programa pwedeng magkaigwa nin nagkapirang tema o topic, kaya an mga tema asin topic dae nag-aadd up sa total.
explore.guide.about.caveat.themes.src: A program can have several themes or topics, so themes and topics do not add up to the total.

explore.guide.about.caveat.income.text: An income iyo an kuwartang pig-aasahan kan {lgu} na maresibe. Dae ini nauunpisa na pig-aadd sa spending.
explore.guide.about.caveat.income.src: Income is the money the {lgu} expects to receive. It is never added to spending.

explore.guide.about.caveat.funds.text: An mga pondo na espesyal, arog kan  20% Development Fund asin disaster fund, mga klase ini nin kuwarta, bakong opisina. Hanapon sinda sa irarom kan Fund.
explore.guide.about.caveat.funds.src: Special funds, such as the 20% Development Fund and the disaster fund, are kinds of money, not offices. Find them under Fund.

explore.guide.about.link.aipVsAnnual.text: An AIP asin an Annual Budget: pano sinda nagkakalaen
explore.guide.about.link.aipVsAnnual.src: The AIP and the Annual Budget: how they differ

explore.guide.about.link.glossary.text: Ipinaliwanag an mga termino sa budget

explore.teach.total.text: {measure} sa {document}: {total} sa gabos. I-break down ta mahiling kun sain ini napapaduman.
explore.teach.total.src: {measure} in the {document}: {total} in all. Break it down to see where it goes.

explore.teach.ask.text: Mag-ask nin hapot sa chat, arog kan “gastos sa health sa 2027”.
explore.teach.ask.src: Ask a question in the chat, like “health spending in 2027”.

explore.teach.drag.text: I-drag an sarong breakdown, arog kan Office, hale sa walang parte pasiring sa Rows, o i-click ini.
explore.teach.drag.src: Drag a breakdown, such as Office, from the left onto Rows, or click it.

explore.teach.starter.text: O magbukas nin starter workbook asin himayon ini:
explore.teach.starter.src: Or open a starter workbook and pick it apart:

explore.teach.empty.text: Mayong nagtutugma sa sheet na ini. Hali an sarong filter sa taas, o i-tick an ibang dokumento sa wala.
explore.teach.empty.src: Nothing matches this sheet. Remove a filter above, or tick another document on the left.

explore.chat.clear.text: Halion an chat kan sheet na ini

explore.chat.forSheet.text: An chat na ini para sa “{sheet}”. An lambang sheet igwa nin sadiring chat.
explore.chat.forSheet.src: This chat belongs to “{sheet}”. Each sheet keeps its own.

cycle.stage.0.who.0.role.text: nagpapadalagan kan lado nin pagplano asin nagtatago kan rekord
cycle.stage.0.who.0.role.src: runs the planning side and keeps the record

cycle.stage.0.you.0.text: Ini an pinakamadaling momento para ribayan an plano kan {lgu}.
cycle.stage.0.you.0.src: This is the easiest moment to change what the {lgu} plans.

cycle.stage.1.title.text: Nagsusurat nin mga plano an mga opisina

cycle.stage.1.summary.text: Kada opisina kan {lgu} naglilista kan mga pinaplano kaining gibuhon sa masunod na taon asin kun nano an magigin gastos kaiyan.
cycle.stage.1.summary.src: Every {lguAdj} office lists what it plans to do next year and what it would cost.

cycle.stage.1.what.text: Kada opisina kan {lgu} naglilista kan mga programa, proyekto asin aktibidad na gusto kaiyan na ipadagos sa masunod na taon, asin pig-e-estima kun nano an magigin gastos kan kada saro. Pinipisan kan opisina nin pagplano an mga ini sa sarong dokumento, an Annual Investment Program.
cycle.stage.1.what.src: Every {lguAdj} office lists the programs, projects and activities it wants to carry out next year, and estimates what each would cost. The planning office puts them together into one document, the Annual Investment Program.

cycle.stage.1.who.0.role.text: nagpo-propose kan sadiri kaining mga programa asin gastos
cycle.stage.1.who.0.role.src: proposes its own programs and costs

cycle.stage.1.who.1.role.text: pinagsasaro asin pigche-check an mga ini

cycle.stage.1.out.0.meaning.text: kada pig-propose na programa, siisay an nagpapadalagan, nuarin, asin kun nano an magigin gastos kaiyan
cycle.stage.1.out.0.meaning.src: every proposed program, who runs it, when, and what it would cost

cycle.stage.1.you.text: Basahon an mga proposal sa site na ini asin magpadara nin feedback sa ano man na programa. Kada pahina nin programa igwa nin feedback form.
cycle.stage.1.you.src: Read the proposals on this site and send feedback on any program. Every program page has a feedback form.

cycle.stage.1.know.text: An AIP sarong plano na may mga price tag, bakong pondo pa. Ini an ipinapahiling kan mga pahina kan AIP sa site na ini.
cycle.stage.1.know.src: The AIP is a plan with price tags, not money yet. This is what the AIP pages on this site show.

cycle.stage.2.summary.text: Inaaprubaran kan {LguAdj} Development Council an plano.
cycle.stage.2.summary.src: The {LguAdj} Development Council approves the plan.

cycle.stage.2.what.0.text: Sinisiyasat kan {LguAdj} Development Council an plano dangan inaaprubaran ini.
cycle.stage.2.what.0.src: The {LguAdj} Development Council reviews the plan and approves it.

cycle.stage.2.what.2.text: Poon digdi, an sarong programa sa pangkagabsan dapat yaon sa AIP tanganing makakua nin pondo sa budget.
cycle.stage.2.what.2.src: From here on, a program generally has to be in the AIP to receive money in the budget.

cycle.stage.2.who.0.role.text: pinamamayohan kan {Mayor}, kaiba an mga kapitan kan barangay asin mga representante kan CSO
cycle.stage.2.who.0.role.src: chaired by the {Mayor}, with barangay captains and CSO representatives

cycle.stage.2.out.0.meaning.text: an lista kan mga programang pwedeng pondohan kan budget
cycle.stage.2.out.0.meaning.src: the list of programs the budget may fund

cycle.stage.3.title.text: Pagtutugma kan mga plano sa kuwarta

cycle.stage.3.short.text: budget call, mga proposal, mga hearing

cycle.stage.3.summary.text: Pinuputulan an mga kahagadan kan mga opisina sagkod na magigo sa kuwartang piglalauman na kolektahon kan {lgu}.
cycle.stage.3.summary.src: Offices’ requests are cut until they fit the money the {lgu} expects to collect.

cycle.stage.3.what.text: Pig-eestimar kan Treasurer asin Assessor kun gurano an kokolektahon kan {lgu} sa masunod na taon. Dangan nagpapadara an {Mayor} nin Budget Call sa lambang opisina: kun gurano an pwedeng hagadon kaini, asin paano. Nagsusumite an mga opisina kan saindang mga proposal sa budget, asin an Local Finance Committee nagkakaigwa nin hearing sa lambang opisina tanganing putulan an mga kahagadan sagkod na magigo.
cycle.stage.3.what.src: The Treasurer and Assessor estimate how much the {lgu} will collect next year. The {Mayor} then sends every office a Budget Call: how much it may ask for, and how. Offices submit their budget proposals, and the Local Finance Committee holds a hearing with each office to cut the requests until they fit.

cycle.stage.3.who.0.role.text: an mga payo kan planning, budget asin treasury
cycle.stage.3.who.0.role.src: the heads of planning, budget and treasury

cycle.stage.3.who.1.role.text: nagluluwas kan Budget Call asin pinagsasaro an mga proposal
cycle.stage.3.who.1.role.src: issues the Budget Call and combines the proposals

cycle.stage.3.who.3.role.text: nagsusumite nin proposal asin pigdedepensahan ini
cycle.stage.3.who.3.role.src: submits a proposal and defends it

cycle.stage.3.out.0.meaning.text: an mga instruksyon asin limitasyon sa gastos na ipinapadara sa lambang opisina
cycle.stage.3.out.0.meaning.src: the instructions and spending limits sent to every office

cycle.stage.3.out.1.meaning.text: an kahagadan nin kuwarta kan lambang opisina

cycle.stage.3.out.2.meaning.text: an piglalauman na bakalon kan lambang opisina, na pigpreparar kaiba an proposal kaini
cycle.stage.3.out.2.meaning.src: what each office expects to buy, prepared with its proposal

cycle.stage.3.you.text: Ining mga hearing panlaog sana sa {lgu} hall. An pinakamarhay na dalan iyo mas amay, sa paagi kan plano, o paghaloyhaloy, sa mga hearing kan {lguAdj} council.
cycle.stage.3.you.src: These hearings are internal to the {lguAdj} government. The best way in is earlier, through the plan, or later, at the {lguAdj} council’s hearings.

cycle.stage.3.know.text: Digdi dakol na kantidad kan AIP an nagbabago. Nangyayari ini sa parehong panahon kan mga tangga na 1 asin 2: an plano asin an budget pighihiras asin pigbabaliktad sagkod na magkauruyon.
cycle.stage.3.know.src: This is where many AIP amounts change. It happens at the same time as stages 1 and 2: the plan and the budget are adjusted back and forth until they agree.

cycle.stage.4.who.0.role.text: isinusumite an budget asin an Budget Message
cycle.stage.4.who.0.role.src: submits the budget and the Budget Message

cycle.stage.4.out.0.meaning.text: an proposed budget kan {Mayor}, naka-organisar sa kada opisina asin klase nin gastuson
cycle.stage.4.out.0.meaning.src: the {Mayor}’s proposed budget, organized by office and type of expense

cycle.stage.4.out.1.meaning.text: an paliwanag kan {Mayor} kun para saen an budget
cycle.stage.4.out.1.meaning.src: the {Mayor}’s explanation of what the budget is for

cycle.stage.4.you.text: Pagkasumite, an proposed budget pwedeng basahon asin pag-ulayan sa publiko. Ipapahiling kan site na ini kun pano nagbago an kada item sa pag-ultan kan plano asin kan proposal na ini.
cycle.stage.4.you.src: Once submitted, the proposed budget can be read and discussed in public. This site will show how each item changed between the plan and this proposal.

cycle.stage.4.know.text: An LEP naka-areglo sa kada opisina asin klase nin gastuson (mga sweldo, supplies, equipment), bakong sa kada programa, kaya iba an hitsura kaini sa AIP dawa pareho an kwarta.
cycle.stage.4.know.src: The LEP is arranged by office and type of expense (salaries, supplies, equipment), not by program, so it looks different from the AIP even where the money is the same.

cycle.stage.5.who.0.role.text: nagkakaigwa kan mga hearing asin bobotohan an budget
cycle.stage.5.who.0.role.src: holds the hearings and votes on the budget

cycle.stage.5.who.1.role.text: magpaliwanag asin magdepensa kan saindang mga budget sa mga hearing
cycle.stage.5.who.1.role.src: explain and defend their budgets at the hearings

cycle.stage.5.out.0.meaning.text: an budget na inaprubahan kan konseho, ipinadara sa {Mayor} para pirmahan
cycle.stage.5.out.0.meaning.src: the budget the council approved, sent to the {Mayor} to sign

cycle.stage.5.you.1.text: Ini na an huring oportunidad na magtaram bago magin ley an mga numero.
cycle.stage.5.you.1.src: This is the last chance to speak before the figures become law.

cycle.stage.5.know.text: An ley naghahagad sa konseho na tawan nin prioridad an budget, tanganing ini maipasar bago magpuon an taon.
cycle.stage.5.know.src: The law asks the council to give the budget priority, so that it is passed before the year starts.

cycle.stage.6.summary.text: Pigpipirmahan kan {Mayor} an budget, o pigbe-veto an mga item kaini. Pag napirmahan na, iyo na ini an Annual Budget.
cycle.stage.6.summary.src: The {Mayor} signs the budget, or vetoes items in it. Signed, it is the Annual Budget.

cycle.stage.6.what.text: Pigpipirmahan kan {Mayor} an budget na ipinasar kan konseho, o pigbe-veto an partikular na mga item kaini. Kun an {Mayor} dai maghiro sa laog nin sampulong aldaw, ini magkaka-epekto na garo baga pinirmahan. Pag napirmahan na, an plano magigin Annual Budget: permiso na gumastos, sa ley.
cycle.stage.6.what.src: The {Mayor} signs the budget the council passed, or vetoes particular items in it. If the {Mayor} does not act within ten days, it takes effect as if signed. Once signed, the plan becomes the Annual Budget: permission to spend, in law.

cycle.stage.6.who.0.role.text: pigpirmahan an ordinance, o pigve-veto an mga espesipikong items
cycle.stage.6.who.0.role.src: signs the ordinance, or vetoes specific items

cycle.stage.6.who.1.role.text: pwedeng ipasa giraray an sarong na-veto na item kun dos-tersiyo kan mga miyembro kaini an magboto na i-override
cycle.stage.6.who.1.role.src: can still pass a vetoed item if two-thirds of its members vote to override

cycle.stage.6.out.0.meaning.text: an Annual Budget: ano an pwedeng gastuson kan {lgu} sa masunod na taon, susog sa ley
cycle.stage.6.out.0.meaning.src: the Annual Budget: what the {lgu} may spend next year, by law

cycle.stage.6.out.1.meaning.text: arong mga item an nireject kan {Mayor}, asin kung tadaw
cycle.stage.6.out.1.meaning.src: which items the {Mayor} rejected, and why

cycle.stage.6.you.text: Mayong pampublikong step digdi, pero an naka-sign na budget sarong pampublikong record. Ipinapahiling ini kan site na ini sa mga pahina kan Annual Budget.
cycle.stage.6.you.src: There is no public step here, but the signed budget is a public record. This site shows it in the Annual Budget pages.

cycle.stage.6.know.text: Kun mayong budget na mag-epekto pag-abot nin Enero, an {lgu} nag-ooperar gamit an budget kan nakaaging taon, para sana sa mga essential na gastos, sagkod na mag-epekto an bago.
cycle.stage.6.know.src: If no budget takes effect by January, the {lgu} runs on last year’s budget, for essential costs only, until the new one does.

cycle.stage.7.summary.text: Sinisigurado kan nasyunal na departamento nin budget na an budget nagsusunod sa mga reglamento.
cycle.stage.7.summary.src: The national budget department checks the budget follows the rules.

cycle.stage.7.what.text: An regional office kan Department of Budget and Management nagche-check na an budget nagsusunod sa mga nasyunal na reglamento, arog kan limit sa gastuson para sa mga sweldo asin kan required shares para sa development asin disaster funds. Igwa ini nin 90 na aldaw.
cycle.stage.7.what.src: The Department of Budget and Management’s regional office checks that the budget follows national rules, such as the limit on spending for salaries and the required shares for development and disaster funds. It has 90 days.

cycle.stage.7.out.0.meaning.text: an arinman na item na nagbabarako nin reglamento pwedeng ideklarar na mayong epekto
cycle.stage.7.out.0.meaning.src: any item that breaks the rules can be declared without effect

cycle.stage.7.you.text: Mayong pampublikong step digdi. An resulta kan review parte kan record kan budget kan {lgu}.
cycle.stage.7.you.src: There is no public step here. The review result is part of the {lgu}’s budget record.

cycle.stage.8.summary.text: Pigkakapot kan mga opisina an saindang mga programa, pigbabakal an kaipuhan ninda, asin pigbabayadan ini.
cycle.stage.8.summary.src: Offices carry out their programs, buy what they need, and pay for it.

cycle.stage.8.what.text: Pigkakapot kan mga opisina an saindang mga programa. Pinapinalisar kan kada saro kun ano an saiyang babakalon, pinagsasararo kan Bids and Awards Committee an mga ini sa procurement plan kan {lgu} asin nagpapadalagan nin public bidding, tapos pigrerelease an kuwarta mantang piggigibo an trabaho.
cycle.stage.8.what.src: Offices carry out their programs. Each finalizes what it will buy, the Bids and Awards Committee combines these into the {lgu}’s procurement plan and runs public bidding, and money is released as work is done.

cycle.stage.8.who.1.role.text: nagpapadalagan nin public bidding para sa mga pigbabakal kan {lgu}
cycle.stage.8.who.1.role.src: runs public bidding for what the {lgu} buys

cycle.stage.8.out.0.meaning.text: kun ano talaga an babakalon kan kada opisina
cycle.stage.8.out.0.meaning.src: what each office will actually buy

cycle.stage.8.out.1.meaning.text: kada planong pagbakal kan {lgu}, sa sarong listahan
cycle.stage.8.out.1.meaning.src: every planned purchase of the {lgu}, in one list

cycle.stage.8.out.2.meaning.text: mga bagong ordinances na nagbabago kan budget sa laog kan taon
cycle.stage.8.out.2.meaning.src: new ordinances that change the budget during the year

cycle.stage.8.you.text: An mga Observer hali sa CSOs pwedeng magsit-in sa public bidding. An mga pahina kan Projects sa site na ini nagpapahiling kun ano an mga plano kan mga opisina na bakalon.
cycle.stage.8.you.src: Observers from CSOs can sit in on public bidding. The Projects pages on this site show what offices plan to buy.

cycle.stage.8.know.text: An budget line permiso ini, bakong spending. Asin an budget pwedeng magbago pa sa laog kan taon, alagad sa paagi sana nin saro pang ordinance na pigpasar kan konseho.
cycle.stage.8.know.src: A budget line is permission, not spending. And the budget can still change during the year, but only through another ordinance passed by the council.

cycle.stage.9.summary.text: Irinereport kan {lgu} kun nano an piggastos kaini, asin pigche-check ini kan Commission on Audit.
cycle.stage.9.summary.src: The {lgu} reports what it spent, and the Commission on Audit checks it.

cycle.stage.9.what.text: Irinereport kan {lgu} an piggastos kontra sa inaprobaran, pigche-check kan planning office an progreso kan mga proyekto, asin pig-audit kan Commission on Audit an mga account tapos nagpapublikar nin audit report pagkatapos kan taon.
cycle.stage.9.what.src: The {lgu} reports what it spent against what was approved, the planning office checks how projects are progressing, and the Commission on Audit examines the accounts and publishes an audit report after the year ends.

cycle.stage.9.out.0.meaning.src: what was spent against what was approved

cycle.stage.9.out.1.meaning.text: Mga nanompongan kan COA sa mga account kan {lgu}, ipinublikar online
cycle.stage.9.out.1.meaning.src: COA’s findings on the {lgu}’s accounts, published online

cycle.stage.9.you.text: Basaha an audit report kan {lgu} sa website kan COA, asin ikumpara ini sa kung nano an pinlano sa site na ini.
cycle.stage.9.you.src: Read the {lgu}’s audit report on the COA website, and compare it with what was planned on this site.

cycle.stage.9.know.text: Ini an lugar kun sain mo pwedeng checkingon kun an permiso nagin sarong bagay na nahihiling mo.
cycle.stage.9.know.src: This is where you can check whether permission became something you can see.

cycle.phase.0.title.text: Mga Capacity Workshop asin Sectoral Consultations

cycle.phase.1.title.src: Preparation of the Annual Investment Program (AIP)

cycle.lanePeople.budget.text: opisina kan budget, komite sa pinansya, mga opisina kan {lgu}

glossary.0.blurb.text: Ini an pagkakaiba na pigsentroan kan bilog na site na ini.
glossary.0.blurb.src: The distinction this whole site is organized around.

glossary.0.entries.0.definition.text: An plano kan {lgu} para sa sarong taon: gabos na pigproponer kan mga opisina kaini na gibuhon, asin an pig-aasahan nindang magastos. Ini an taon na parte kan mas halawig na plano sa pag-uswag. Sarong plano lang — mayong pwedeng gastuson base sana digdi.
glossary.0.entries.0.definition.src: The {lgu}'s plan for one year: everything its offices propose to do, and what they expect it to cost. It is the year's slice of a longer development plan. A plan only — nothing may be spent on the strength of it.

glossary.0.entries.1.definition.text: An pinansyal na plano para sa sarong taon fiscal, pagpasar na kan Sanggunian asin napirmahan na kan {Mayor}. Ini an dokumento na nag-aautorisa nin paggasto, asin an dahilan kun tano an enacted year sa site na ini pigsasabi bilang ley imbes na proposal.
glossary.0.entries.1.definition.src: The financial plan for one fiscal year, once the Sanggunian has passed it and the {Mayor} has signed it. This is the document that authorizes spending, and the reason the enacted year on this site is described as law rather than proposal.

glossary.0.entries.2.definition.text: Permiso para gumastos nin sarong stated amount para sa sarong stated purpose, pigtao kan ordinance. An kada piso sa site na ini sarong appropriation — permiso, bakong rekord kan kuwarta na naghale na sa treasury.
glossary.0.entries.2.definition.src: Permission to spend a stated amount for a stated purpose, granted by ordinance. Every peso on this site is an appropriation — permission, not a record of money that has left the treasury.

glossary.0.entries.3.definition.text: An lokal na ley na nag-e-enact kan budget. Ipinapasar ini kan Sanggunian asin pigpipirmahan kan {Mayor}; an pirma iyo an momento na an plano nagigin budget.
glossary.0.entries.3.definition.src: The local law that enacts the budget. The Sanggunian passes it and the {Mayor} signs it; the signature is the moment a plan becomes a budget.

glossary.0.entries.4.definition.text: Sarong budget na ipinapasar pagkatapos kan Annual Budget, tanganing baguhon ini. Ini an paagi kun pano nagsisimbag an {lgu} sa sarong bagay na dai nahiling kan orihinal na budget.
glossary.0.entries.4.definition.src: A budget enacted after the Annual Budget, to change it. It is how a {lgu} responds to something the original budget did not foresee.

glossary.0.entries.5.definition.text: An proposed budget kan {Mayor} para sa masunod na taon, inaapod man na Executive Budget, ipigpadara sa Sanggunian pag-Oktubre. Pigpapakarhay ini segun sa opisina asin klase kan gastuson imbes na segun sa programa, asin digdi pigpatakaran na an plano para magkasyahan sa income na pig-e-expect kan {lgu}.
glossary.0.entries.5.definition.src: The {Mayor}'s proposed budget for next year, also called the Executive Budget, sent to the Sanggunian in October. It is arranged by office and type of expense rather than by program, and it is where the plan has been cut to fit the income the {lgu} expects.

glossary.0.entries.6.definition.text: An instruksyon kan {Mayor} sa lambang opisina pagpuon kan preparasyon kan budget: magkakano an pwede nindang hagadon, asin kun pano maghagad.
glossary.0.entries.6.definition.src: The {Mayor}'s instructions to every office at the start of budget preparation: how much it may ask for, and how to ask.

glossary.0.entries.7.definition.text: An poder kan {Mayor} na i-veto an partikular na mga item sa budget na pinasar kan Sanggunian. An sarong na-veto na item pwedeng makapasar pa man giraray kun an duwa-tersiyo kan Sanggunian magboto na i-override.
glossary.0.entries.7.definition.src: The {Mayor}’s power to reject particular items in the budget the Sanggunian passed. A vetoed item can still pass if two-thirds of the Sanggunian vote to override.

glossary.1.blurb.text: An appropriation nagigin gastuson sa paagi nin mga lakdang, asin an kada saro igwa nin sadiring tataramon.
glossary.1.blurb.src: An appropriation becomes spending in steps, and each has its own word.

glossary.1.entries.0.definition.text: An awtoridad na itinao sa sarong opisina para magpuon magcommit nin kuwarta na pig-appropriar na kan ordinance. Sa tahaw kan pagkaigwa nin permiso asin pagigin pwedeng gamiton ini kan opisina.
glossary.1.entries.0.definition.src: The authority given to an office to start committing money that the ordinance has appropriated. Between permission existing and an office being able to use it.

glossary.1.entries.1.definition.text: Sarong commitment na an {lgu} obligado nang bayadan — sarong pirmadong kontrata, purchase order, payroll. An kuwarta dai pa nawawara, pero bako na ini libre.
glossary.1.entries.1.definition.src: A commitment the {lgu} is now bound to pay — a signed contract, a purchase order, a payroll. The money is not gone, but it is no longer free.

glossary.1.entries.2.definition.text: An aktwal na kuwartang naghahale sa treasury. Ini sana sa apat an nangangahulugan na an kuwarta nagasto na, asin bako ini an pigrerekord kan site na ini.
glossary.1.entries.2.definition.src: Cash actually leaving the treasury. This is the only one of the four that means money has been spent, and it is not what this site records.

glossary.1.entries.3.definition.text: Sarong appropriation na pwedeng magamit lagpas pa sa katapusan kan taon kan budget, para sa mga bagay arog kan konstruksyon na dai matatapos sa laog nin doseng bulan.
glossary.1.entries.3.definition.src: An appropriation that stays available past the end of the budget year, for things like construction that cannot finish inside twelve months.

glossary.2.heading.text: Pagbakal kan mga bagay na pinagbabayadan kan budget
glossary.2.heading.src: Buying what the budget pays for

glossary.2.blurb.text: Kun pano pigpaplano kan {lgu} an mga binakalon kaini pag-aram na kun magkano an pwedeng gastuson.
glossary.2.blurb.src: How the {lgu} plans its purchases once it knows what it may spend.

glossary.2.entries.0.definition.text: Kun ano an pigpaplanong bakalon kan sarong opisina para sa mga programa kaini, asin kun nuarin. Sarong draft an piggigibo kaiba kan proposal kan budget; an pinal pagkatapos na ma-enact an budget. Sa site na ini, ini an mga pahina kan Projects.
glossary.2.entries.0.definition.src: What one office plans to buy for its programs, and when. A draft is made with the budget proposal; the final one after the budget is enacted. On this site these are the Projects pages.

glossary.2.entries.1.definition.text: An lambang binakalon na pigpaplano kan {lgu} para sa taon, pinagsararo hali sa PPMP kan gabos na opisina kan Bids and Awards Committee.
glossary.2.entries.1.definition.src: Every purchase the {lgu} plans for the year, combined from all the offices' PPMPs by the Bids and Awards Committee.

glossary.2.entries.2.definition.text: An komite na iyo an nagpapadalagan kan public bidding para sa mga pigbabakal kan {lgu}. An mga observer hali sa CSOs pwedeng magsit-in.
glossary.2.entries.2.definition.src: The committee that runs public bidding for what the {lgu} buys. Observers from CSOs may sit in.

glossary.3.blurb.text: An lambang piso pigkaklasipika sa duwang paagi: sa kun ano an pigbabakal, asin sa kun sain ini nakabugtak sa libro.
glossary.3.blurb.src: Every peso is classified two ways: by what it buys, and by where it sits in the book.

glossary.3.entries.0.definition.text: Sahod asin benepisyo para sa mga tawo na naggigibo kan trabaho — sweldo, allowances, retirement asin leave benefits, asin an gasto sa pagpano nin mga pwesto.
glossary.3.entries.0.definition.src: Pay and benefits for the people who do the work — salaries, allowances, retirement and leave benefits, and the cost of filling posts.

glossary.3.entries.1.definition.text: An gasto sa pagpadalagan kan serbisyo sa aro-aldaw: supplies, gasolina asin biyahe, kuryente asin tubig, pagkumpuni.
glossary.3.entries.1.definition.src: The cost of running services day to day: supplies, fuel and travel, electricity and water, repairs.

glossary.3.entries.2.definition.text: Mga bank charges, interest sa mga utang asin iba pang pinansyal na singil. Ipinapahiling bilang sadiri kaining kantidad poon pa kan budget manual kan 2023; sa mga naenot na budget, binibilang ini sa irarom kan MOOE.
glossary.3.entries.2.definition.src: Bank charges, interest on loans and other financial charges. Shown as its own amount since the 2023 budget manual; earlier budgets counted it under MOOE.

glossary.3.entries.3.definition.text: Gastuson sa mga bagay na an pakinabang mas halawig pa sa taon asin na magigin rogaring kan {lgu} — mga edipisyo, kagamitan, tinampo, pampublikong saod.
glossary.3.entries.3.definition.src: Spending on things whose benefit outlasts the year and which the {lgu} then owns — buildings, equipment, roads, public markets.

glossary.3.entries.4.definition.text: An seksyon kan budget na minasakop kan gasto para sa pag-eksister pa sana kan sarong opisina: an staff, an opisina kaini, an operational na gastos. Kadaklan kan mga opisina idinudugang an kadaklan kan saindang budget digdi, kaya nagdo-domina ini sa mga total.
glossary.3.entries.4.definition.src: The section of the budget covering the cost of an office existing at all: its staff, its premises, its running costs. Most offices file the bulk of their budget here, which is why it dominates the totals.

glossary.3.entries.5.definition.text: An seksyon na nagtatakop kan mga nagpapadalagan sa frontline na serbisyo gikan sa likod — records, transport, information systems.
glossary.3.entries.5.definition.src: The section covering what makes front-line service possible from behind — records, transport, information systems.

glossary.3.entries.6.definition.text: An seksyon na nagtatakop kan serbisyo na dapat itinatao kan sarong opisina: an klinika, an school feeding, an paghirahay kan tinampo.
glossary.3.entries.6.definition.src: The section covering the service an office exists to deliver: the clinic, the school feeding, the road repair.

glossary.4.heading.text: Kun pano nakaorganisar an mga entries

glossary.4.blurb.text: An itsura kan sarong budget entry, asin an mga tataramon para sa mga parte kaini.
glossary.4.blurb.src: The shape of a budget entry, and the words for its parts.

glossary.4.entries.0.definition.text: An tulong lebel na pwedeng magin sarong budget entry. An program sarong grupo nin konektadong trabaho; an project sarong espesipikong hiro na mayong katapusan na petsa; an activity iyo an padagos na trabaho na nagkokontribuwir sa sarong programa. An sarong program pigsasabi an sadiri kaining amount, o ipinapahiling an suma kan mga projects asin activities sa irarom kaini.
glossary.4.entries.0.definition.src: The three levels a budget entry can be. A program is a group of related work; a project is a specific undertaking with an end date; an activity is ongoing work that contributes to one. A program either states its own amount, or shows the sum of the projects and activities under it.

glossary.4.entries.1.definition.text: An opisina kan {lgu} na responsable sa pagdeliver kan sarong entry asin mayong paninimbagan sa pondo kaini. Bakong awtomatiko an opisina na nakikinabang kaini.
glossary.4.entries.1.definition.src: The {lguAdj} office responsible for delivering an entry and accountable for its money. Not necessarily the office that benefits from it.

glossary.4.entries.2.definition.text: An sadiring numbering kan {lgu} para sa kada entry — sector, level nin gobyerno, tipo nin opisina, an opisina mismo, an seksyon kan libro, dangan an program asin an entry sa laog kaini. Naglalabel ini nin mga rows; dai kaini pigsusuma an mga ini, asin mayo ining taon na dara.
glossary.4.entries.2.definition.src: The {lgu}'s own numbering for each entry — sector, level of government, type of office, the office, the section of the book, then the program and the entry within it. It labels rows; it does not add them up, and it carries no year.

glossary.4.entries.4.definition.text: Sarong grupo nin mga opisina kan {lgu} na nagtatrabaho pasiring sa parehong {goal}.
glossary.4.entries.4.definition.src: A grouping of {lguAdj} offices that work towards the same {goal}.

glossary.4.entries.5.definition.text: An pig-aasintang gastos sa sarong AIP entry pag ipigpatupad ini. An AIP sarong lista kan mga planong programa, mas dakol sa kaya kan {lgu}, kaya an estimated cost bakong budget asin daing pigsasapremiyong funding.
glossary.4.entries.5.definition.src: What an AIP entry is expected to cost if it is carried out. The AIP is a list of planned programs, more than the {lgu} can afford, so an estimated cost is not a budget and promises no funding.

glossary.4.entries.6.definition.text: An budget na isusumiter kan {Mayor} sa Sanggunian para sa masunod na taon: an Local Expenditure Program (LEP), hali sa AIP pero limitado sana sa piglalaoman na kakayahan kan {lgu}. An mga AIP na figures sa site na ini estimated costs; an mga enacted na figures appropriations.
glossary.4.entries.6.definition.src: The budget the {Mayor} submits to the Sanggunian for next year: the Local Expenditure Program (LEP), drawn from the AIP but limited to what the {lgu} expects to afford. AIP figures on this site are estimated costs; enacted figures are appropriations.

glossary.5.blurb.text: An sarong {lgu} mayo nin saro sanang purse. Ini an mga nagluluwas sa site na ini.
glossary.5.blurb.src: A {lgu} does not have one purse. These are the ones that appear on this site.

glossary.5.entries.0.definition.text: An pangenot na account kan {lgu}, na may kapot kan saiyang ordinaryong income. Kadaklan kan budget yaon digdi.
glossary.5.entries.0.definition.src: The {lgu}'s main account, holding its ordinary income. Most of the budget is here.

glossary.5.entries.1.definition.text: Sarong parte kan real property tax na pwedeng gastuson sana para sa mga pampublikong eskwelahan asin edukasyon.
glossary.5.entries.1.definition.src: A share of real property tax that may only be spent on public schools and education.

glossary.5.entries.2.definition.text: An 20% kan national tax revenue na dapat itinatao kan sarong {lgu} para sa mga development projects imbes na running costs.
glossary.5.entries.2.definition.src: The 20% of national tax revenue a {lgu} must set aside for development projects rather than running costs.

glossary.5.entries.3.definition.text: 5% kan pigtatantiyang revenue, na nakareserba para sa pagpreparar asin pagresponde sa mga kalamidad.
glossary.5.entries.3.definition.src: 5% of estimated revenue, reserved for preparing for and responding to disasters.

glossary.5.entries.4.definition.text: Pondo na kapot kan {lgu} para sa sarong espesipikong katuyohan para sa ibang tawo, na dai kaini pwedeng i-redirect.
glossary.5.entries.4.definition.src: Money the {lgu} holds for a specific purpose on behalf of someone else, which it may not redirect.

glossary.5.entries.5.definition.text: Pondo hali sa sarong national department para sa trabahong isinasagibo sa lokal.
glossary.5.entries.5.definition.src: Money coming from a national department for work carried out locally.

glossary.6.blurb.text: An mga grupo na pinangaranan sa site na ini, asin an ginigibo kan kada saro.
glossary.6.blurb.src: The bodies named on this site, and what each one does.

glossary.6.entries.0.definition.text: An elected {lguAdj} council ({council}). Sinda an nagkokondusir kan mga budget hearing asin nagpapasar kan appropriation ordinance, na pirminahan kan {Mayor} pagkatapos.
glossary.6.entries.0.definition.src: The elected {lguAdj} council ({council}). It holds the budget hearings and passes the appropriation ordinance, which the {Mayor} then signs.

glossary.6.entries.1.definition.text: An mga opisyal kan {lgu} sa budget, planning asin treasury, na nag-a-assess kun magkano an kaya kan {lgu} asin nagrerekomendar kun pano ini bangaon.
glossary.6.entries.1.definition.src: The {lgu}'s budget, planning and treasury officers, who assess what the {lgu} can afford and recommend how to divide it.

glossary.6.entries.2.definition.text: An grupo na nag-aaprubar kan mga development plans kan {lgu} asin kan Annual Investment Program kaini, pinamamayohan kan {Mayor}, kaiba an mga kapitanes de barangay asin mga representante kan CSO. An ley nag-aapod digding Local Development Council (LDC).
glossary.6.entries.2.definition.src: The body that approves the {lgu}'s development plans and its Annual Investment Program, chaired by the {Mayor}, with barangay captains and CSO representatives. The law calls it the Local Development Council (LDC).

glossary.6.entries.5.definition.text: An national agency na an regional office kaini nagrereview kan budget kan {lgu} pagkatapos na mapirmahan, asin pwedeng magbali nin mga items na nagbabalga sa nasyunal na reglamento.
glossary.6.entries.5.definition.src: The national agency whose regional office reviews the {lgu}'s budget after it is signed, and can strike items that break national rules.

glossary.6.entries.6.definition.text: An national agency na nag-a-audit kun pano ginasto an pampublikong pondo asin pirming pighuhubo an saiyang findings kada taon.
glossary.6.entries.6.definition.src: The national agency that audits how public money was spent and publishes its findings every year.
